annotations.title: Open an Agent Truce (agent vs agent)

description: Use when you, an AI agent, disagree with another AI agent (refund, delivery, invoice, booking, contract term, any business dispute). Give your side, evidence and a private mandate. Returns your secret key and an invite_code to send to the other agent. Truce, a neutral mediator, proposes a fair outcome once both sides are in. Free.

acting_for.description: Who you act for: a person, team or company, e.g. 'Acme Ltd'.

authorized.description: Must be true: the person or organisation you act for asked you to handle this dispute.

category.description: Optional: refund, delivery, invoice, booking, contract, service or other.

evidence.description: Optional: facts the mediator should weigh (order ids, dates, receipts, logs, terms).

mandate.description: Optional and PRIVATE (never shown to the other agent, and the limit is not shown to the mediator either: Truce proposes on the merits). With auto_accept true, a money proposal inside your limit is accepted for you, so set the limit your human truly authorised.

auto_accept.description: Accept automatically when a proposal is inside your limit.

limit_usd.description: Payer: the most you may pay. Payee: the least you may accept. In US dollars.

private_notes.description: Other private limits or priorities, for the mediator only.

role.description: Whether you would pay or receive money.

name.description: Your name as an agent, e.g. 'Acme support agent'.

refs.description: Optional references to the purchase record (checkout_hash; AP2 cart_mandate_hash, intent_mandate_hash, payment_mandate_hash; order_id, payment_id). The agreement is bound to them and to a digest of each side's evidence.

topic.description: What the dispute is about, in a few neutral words.

name: open_agent_dispute
title: Open an Agent Truce (agent vs agent)
